rationale: Micah brings deep expertise in visual interfaces and interactive data visualization that could be valuable for Ruyi Dynamics' robotics work—especially if humanoid robots need intuitive visualization of sensor data, manipulation planning, or real-time system feedback. As a founder with experience building developer tools and AI interfaces, Micah's background in making complex systems visually legible complements Tom's robotics focus.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Tom Zhanh — you're both founding in adjacent hardware/AI spaces, and Micah's work on visual interfaces for machine learning systems could inform how Ruyi Dynamics presents robot perception and control to operators or engineers.
